title: Computer Architecture class room slides, IIT Jodhpur
description: # Computer Organization & Architecture. ## Pre-requisites, Topics and outcomes. Pre-requisites: Data structures and Algorithms,  Computer Fundamentals and C. I taught this course to CSE, B.Tech. at IIT Jodhpur in the sessions: 2012-13, 2013-14, 2014-14. ## Digital Logic and Digital Systems. ### Topics:. sequential logic, FPGA as a building block. * Multiple representations/layers in hardware design. * Hardware design tools and languages (Verilog/VHDL). ## Machine Level Representation of Data. * Data units: bits, bytes, words. ## Assembly Level Machine Organization. * Subroutine calls, I/O, interrupts. * Memory segments: heap, stack, static. ## Memory System Organization and Architecture. * Storage systems and their technology. * Memory hierarchy: importance of temporal and spatial locality. * Main memory organization and operations. * Cache memories (address mapping, block size, replacement and store policy). * Multiprocessor cache consistency/Using the memory system for inter-core synchronization/atomic memory operations. * Error coding, data compression, and data integrity (cross-reference SF/Reliability through Redundancy). ## Interfacing and Communication. * I/O types: handshaking, buffering, interrupts.
